title: PII Shield — Latency
description: Where the time goes in POST /anonymize_unique: waiting for a detection thread or computing, the time per step (NER model, recognizers, post-processing, handling, storing), and the slowest requests with their traces and log lines.

panels.title: Request Time p95
panels.description: How long does the slowest 1 in 20 calls to /anonymize_unique take on the server? The HTTP metric has no size label, so the size filter above does not apply here.

panels.title: Time Spent Waiting
panels.description: Are requests waiting for a detection thread? Share of (wait + detection) time that requests spent in the queue. Near 0 % means the time goes into computing; a high share means too few threads or replicas.

panels.title: Requests With a Second NER Pass
panels.description: How often does a request pay for the second NER pass (case recovery)? That pass can double the detection time of the request.

panels.title: Requests Analysed
panels.description: How many requests the numbers in this row are based on.

panels.title: HTTP Request Duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: How long do calls to /anonymize_unique take on the server, from the first byte to the response? Buckets go up to 120 s, so a 10 to 20 s request is no longer clipped at 10 s.

panels.title: Queue Wait vs Detect Time (p95)
panels.description: Waiting or computing? If the queue-wait line rises, requests are waiting for a free detection thread; if the detect line rises, the detection itself got slower.

panels.title: Second NER Pass: Share of Requests
panels.description: Is the share of requests that run the second NER pass changing over time?

panels.title: Detect Time With and Without the Second Pass (p95)
panels.description: How much does the second NER pass add? p95 detection time for requests that ran it and for those that did not.

panels.title: Average Time per Step
panels.description: Which step takes the time? Average duration of each top-level step when it ran, stacked. Steps that run only sometimes (second pass, app config, auth) are averaged over the requests that ran them, so the stack can exceed the average request.

targets.expr: sum by (step) (rate(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (step) (rate(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Share of Time by Step
panels.description: Where does the time go over the selected range? Share of the summed server time per top-level step (other is what the steps do not cover).

panels.title: p95 per Step
panels.description: Which step is slow for the slowest requests? 95th percentile per top-level step; percentiles do not add up.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, step) (rate(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Details Over Time (Average, Inclusive)
panels.description: How much of nlp_pass1 is the NER model, and how much of analyze is context scoring or dedup? Details are included in their step; never add them to the stack above.

targets.expr: sum by (step) (rate(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step=~".*\\..*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (step) (rate(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step=~".*\\..*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Steps
panels.description: The numbers behind the charts: calls, average, p95 and share of the summed time per top-level step over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__range])) / sum by (step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__range])))

100 * sum by (step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__range])) / scalar(sum(increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step!~".*\\..*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Step Details (Inclusive)
panels.description: How long do the NER model, context scoring and dedup take? Each is measured inside its step (nlp_pass1.ner_model, analyze.dedup, ...): do not add them to the steps.

targets.expr: sum by (step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step=~".*\\..*"}[$__range])) / sum by (step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step=~".*\\..*"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, step) (increase(pii_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="pii-shield", size=~"$size", step=~".*\\..*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Slow Requests (Traces)
panels.description: Which requests were slow? pii_shield.anonymize spans longer than the threshold chosen above (waiting for a thread plus detection plus handling). Open a trace to see its steps.

targets.query: { resource.service.name="pii-shield" && name="pii_shield.anonymize" && duration > ${slow_ms}ms } | select(span.pii.chars, span.pii.queue_ms, span.pii.detect_ms, span.pii.recovery_pass, span.pii.ner_windows)

panels.title: Average Time per Step, From Traces
panels.description: The same question answered from traces (Tempo span metrics) instead of the histogram. Only sampled requests are counted.

panels.title: p95 per Step, From Traces (Coarse)
panels.description: Which step is slow for the slowest requests, according to traces? Tempo buckets double in size, so the values are approximate.

panels.title: Step Spans per Second
panels.description: How often did each step run, according to traces? Shows the optional steps and the effect of trace sampling.

panels.title: Per-Request Log Lines (Slow Requests)
panels.description: What did the slow requests report? The 'Unique anonymization complete' line of every request that waited or detected for longer than the threshold chosen above; its steps= field lists the time per step.

targets.expr: {service_name="pii-shield"} |= "Unique anonymization complete" | pattern "<_>chars=<chars>, queue_ms=<queue_ms>, detect_ms=<detect_ms> (<_>" | detect_ms > ${slow_ms} or queue_ms > ${slow_ms}
